title: Bug Finding With Agentic Symbolic Execution
abstract: arXiv:2611.15596v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Symbolic execution, in tools such as CrossHair for Python, is a powerful technique for finding bugs, but two barriers hinder its adoption: the human effort of annotating code with assertions, and the need to model the execution environment outside Python, such as an external database. To overcome both, we design an agentic harness that orchestrates the symbolic execution tool CrossHair together with an AI coding agent. Without human intervention, it instruments a repository with assertions, synthesizes a constraint-aware symbolic environment for the database, runs symbolic execution, and constructs a concrete test as evidence for each bug it reports. We evaluate our harness on 1,156,044 lines of Python code over 11 popular open-source Python web applications (Zulip, NetBox, Apache Superset, and others). With the synthesized environment, CrossHair executes 81% of the 5,406 contracted functions, against 4.5% without it. Our pipeline find

translated_title: 基于智能体符号执行的漏洞发现
translated_abstract: 符号执行（例如Python的CrossHair等工具所采用的）是一种强大的漏洞发现技术，但有两个障碍阻碍了它的广泛应用：一是需要人工在代码中标注断言，二是需要对Python之外的执行环境（如外部数据库）进行建模。为了同时克服这两个障碍，我们设计了一个智能体框架，将符号执行工具CrossHair与AI编程智能体协同编排。在无需人工干预的情况下，该框架为代码仓库自动添加断言插桩，为数据库合成一个感知约束的符号环境，运行符号执行，并为所报告的每个漏洞构建具体的测试用例作为证据。我们在11个流行的开源Python Web应用（如Zulip、NetBox、Apache Superset等）共1,156,044行Python代码上对该框架进行了评估。借助合成的环境，CrossHair能够执行5,406个带契约函数中的81%，而在没有该环境的情况下仅为4.5%。我们的流程能够发现……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了一个无需人工干预的智能体框架，通过将符号执行工具CrossHair与AI编程智能体协同编排，自动为代码添加断言并为数据库合成符号环境，使可执行的带契约函数比例从4.5%大幅提升至81%，有效发现了真实开源项目中的漏洞。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces an agentic harness that orchestrates the symbolic execution tool CrossHair with an AI coding agent to automatically annotate assertions and synthesize constraint-aware symbolic database environments without human intervention, increasing executed contracted function coverage from 4.5% to 81% and effectively finding bugs in real-world open-source projects.
